title: Kramer Pacer Deluxe, Kerry Green, Exclusive

long_description.title: Take your playing and sound to the next level with this new version of a Kramer icon
long_description.body: Get ready to rock with Kramer’s flagship model, the Pacer! First introduced in 1981, the Pacer is a true icon of the rock world and was used by some of the biggest names in rock and metal in the 1980s. And now, the Pacer Deluxe is here to take things to the next level. This guitar is a tour de force with its sleek body curves, classic beak headstock, and Floyd Rose® 1000 Series double-locking tremolo system. The alder body, with forearm and belly comfort carves and neck heel sculpting, makes it comfortable to hold and easy to access the entire length of the neck. The satin-finished, thermally aged maple neck has a walnut skunk stripe on the rear and a Modern Elliptical C profile. The maple fretboard is equipped with 22 medium jumbo frets and black dot position markers and has a compound (10”-14”) radius for easy chording and choke-free string bends. The truss rod uses a spoke wheel-style adjustment at the body end of the fretboard, making it quick and easy to access, and the 25.5” scale length is great for drop tuning. It also features the new Kramer KeyLock system. The KeyLock, developed by Senior Product Development Engineer Richard Akers, provides incredible neck stability. Paired with Kramer’s five-bolt neck-to-body joint, it prevents movement in the neck pocket, increasing vibrational tone transfer, sustain, and intonation. The Kramer Pacer Deluxe is powered by a Kramer USA Golden Classic humbucker™ in the bridge position and a pair of Kramer USA Triton noiseless pickups. The Kramer USA Triton noiseless neck and middle pickups are great partners with the Kramer USA Golden Classic humbucker, and they balance and complement each other beautifully in terms of tone and output. While this updated version of the Pacer is not a direct reissue, it retains the iconic Kramer DNA with modern touches that will get your heart racing. Like all of our guitars, it still has plenty of in-your-face, Made to Rock Hard attitude and all of the features that modern guitarists demand. A premium gig bag is also included. Get ready to shred like never before with the Pacer Deluxe!

Neck Specs.Fingerboard Radius: Compound, 10 in. to 14 in. | 254 mm to 355.6 mm
Neck Specs.Joint: Bolt On with Ferrules and Kramer KeyLock System

Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Kramer Logo in Gold with Black Outline
